title: Recyclable corrugated beverage container and holder
abstract: Corrugated beverage containers and holders employ recyclable materials with fluting structures containing insulating air. These products are easy to hold and have lesser environmental impact than polystyrene containers.
gist: This patent describes beverage cup holders and cups made from recyclable corrugated paper instead of polystyrene. Wavy fluting traps insulating air pockets, providing thermal protection similar to foam while remaining recyclable — the ancestor of the modern coffee cup sleeve.
